notes.title: Game and Update Status
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 



It's been some time since we've made an announcement. We were aware of it at that time, some concerns and frustrations arose. Even some thought the game had been abandoned or development had stopped. But that was never the case; the game was and still is in full development. Let's start by answering the most asked question during this period:



Why the silence, lack of information?

With the new update contents and technical improvements, we weren't sure if they were feasible or not, whether we would start from scratch, or come up with an entirely new plan. We needed to know and be sure that the code infrastructure would handle the changes, and we were prepared to make adjustments if necessary. 

In the end, we wanted to deliver a beautiful update for our players, for you guys, we had to do more than we could do, that's why we weren't sure. We had to make a choice; either we would turn back from what we said, giving you all a false expectation and hope, or wait until everything is stable and confirmed. We chose the way that we believe was safer. After countless trial-and-error, internal tests, crashes, bugs, and problem-solving, now it's safe to announce what's coming in the next update/what's new. 



We all sincerely appreciate your passion, support, and patience!



Now, it's time to see what's new and what's coming!


Unreal Engine 5.5 Migration (from 5.3)
We've moved the entire project from Unreal 5.3 to 5.5. Why?

Necessary for full controller support

Better performance through the game

Support for up-to-date features

A better and newer engine version overall, with more features

This migration took time and effort, but it was absolutely worth it for the long-term stability of the game.


Full Controller Support
It's finally here!

Every action in the game (from menus to cooking) can now be done with a controller

Plug-and-play, meaning no complicated setups

A more comfortable gameplay experience

Some improvements/adjustments to menu visuals to support controllers

Fast Food Simulator is now fully playable with a gamepad. Lean back and enjoy the game!


Changing Matchmaking Infrastructure to Epic Online Services (EOS)
Our multiplayer backbone has been switched to EOS.

It's a necessity for future possible cross-play plans

High and better compatibility with Unreal Engine

A better infrastructure than the previous matchmaking system

We want playing with friends to feel smooth and enjoyable without technical interruptions.


A Mini Open World!
Probably the most exciting part of the update!

Places where you can deliver orders

A new, sizzlin' hot mini open world that you can explore

You're no longer stuck in a small restaurant

If possible, drivable vehicles to deliver orders (If! That's on the table — no promises yet)







Once again, we would like to thank you all for sticking with us! We'll be with you soon to share some screenshots and peeks from the update. Until then, keep cookin'!   



Let's keep making Fast Food Simulator better together!

notes.title: When is the update? FAQ and First Looks into the Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We are getting a lot of questions regarding the next update, so we wanted to answer some frequently asked questions and give you some sneak peeks from the upcoming update.

First, let's start with questions, and at the end there will be sneak peeks about the update!


When is the next update? Is the game abandoned?

No, the game is not abandoned. Right now, we are working on the 0.3.0 update. December was spent resting and company work (as we're newly founded, there was tons of legal work to do) after the Early Access release. Some of this work was postponed to January, and to add, there are new additions to our development team, which required more time to get to know each other, orientate, and get used to working as a team. 

As we're all good about these now, we've already made a lot of progress developing the update. And to answer that ultimate question, we will release the update when we think it is ready. We want to give you as smooth and an enjoyable experience as possible. You can follow the developments on the Roadmap until then. You can find the Roadmap here: Roadmap

Will there be customization of the restaurant table-chair designs?

Yes, not in the upcoming update, but we are planning to work on it in the next update.

Will there be new AI's? What are your thoughts on them?

At first, we never thought/planned AI workers for the game. After the Demo/Prologue, we managed to put in some AI's for the release at the last minute due to the intense demand of our players. We're planning to add a few more AI's that will reduce the workload of solo players in the future (although these AI's will not handle everything). However, the restaurant business will never be fully automated. You can follow these on the Roadmap.

Full Controller Support, Releasing on Consoles and Crossplay

Right now, Full Controller Support is in our Roadmap; if we can integrate that into the game smoothly, we will put Consoles and Cross-platform support on our agenda.

You made a lot of money; why haven't you changed the AI arts yet?

We're getting a lot of complaints from players about AI Steam assets. Yes, this was done in the first place because of financial impossibility; we are also uncomfortable with them and want to change. We want our game to have its own unique assets. Don't worry, that's still on our list; unfortunately, our current earnings have not reached the company yet (because of the way Steam handles things). Once we receive, we will renew all our AI art. We don't want them to be worse than the current ones, and we want to get better ones by paying the artists well.



It's time for the sneak peeks! 

Here is a Refilling Soda Machine, which works using soda syrups and needs you to refill it when it runs out! No more endless drinks; time to work, chop chop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093039/b9d448f97387111a4f9fedec1017dfb3a816e6c6.png



We also went under redesigning some UI's to increase user experience and to make the market and computer UI's look more beautiful. Everyone pays attention to their looks, right?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093039/2b68bff31726df42a3c5fd003adad700388ff31c.jpg


That's it from us for now; we hope we could answer your concerns and questions in mind. Thank you for your understanding and patience. Until then, see you soon!



Curious what's more to come? Check our roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pRcyYpln/fast-food-simulator-roadmap


If you want to have a chat with the community, give feedback and some ideas; join our discord here: https://discord.gg/noceilinggames

notes.title: Update v0.2.0

Hello everyone,

We received many complaints from our players that they were unable to play in normal mode after drive-thru was activated. To fix this, we added a new difficulty mode between normal and easy.

The difficulty modes are now as follows:


 Easy (same)
 Normal (newly added)
 Hard (previously Normal)
 Very Hard (previously Hard)
 Nightmare (previously Very Hard)


Fixed:


 Some players were joining other players' lobbies and hiding burger flippers before. After we fixed this, they started hiding Burger Trays under the freezer shelves and other shelves. We fixed this too.
 Localization fixes
